0022600182.text: The Nuggets (3-2, 1-1 at home, on a two-game winning streak, third in the Northwest and one game back, eighth in the West) host the Raptors (3-3, 2-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak, third in the Atlantic and three games back, seventh in the East) in Denver's seventh game of the season. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee, sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Toronto is without Jakob Poeltl (shoulder, inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
